description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Light Focus

Benefit: As long as you have a light spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can take a swift action to see normally in any conditions of illumination for 1 round, with a range of 10 feet per level of the highest-level light spell you can cast. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting light spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Light Focus
